is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae s.s. and An. coluzzii) in Côte d'Ivoire.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotype frequencies for Vgsc L995F (kdr L1014F) and Ace-1 G280S (G119S) in Table 3.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 provides genotype counts (SS, RS, RR) for kdr L1014F and Ace-1 G119S for both An. gambiae and An. coluzzii.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from natural breeding habitats in Ehania-V1, Côte d'Ivoire.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field collection and laboratory analysis.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study site is Ehania-V1, Aboisso, Côte d'Ivoire.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Larvae were collected between June and July 2013.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a specific, localized collection in an industrial palm farm (Ehania-V1) in 2013.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and bioassay results, are provided in the main text tables.

assessment.summary: This study assessed insecticide susceptibility and resistance mechanisms in Anopheles gambiae s.l. from an industrial palm farm in Ehania-V1, Côte d'Ivoire. It reports high frequencies of kdr L1014F and low frequencies of Ace-1 G119S, alongside bioassay results for six insecticides.
